judgement.reason: The passages support that the mole, one of four SI base units, was redefined effective 20 May 2019 and that one mole contains exactly 6.02214076×10²³ elementary entities as the fixed Avogadro constant. They do not support the phrasing 'from a base unit to a unit' or the incomplete 'previous mole' part.

units.text: The 2019 standard changed the mole from a base unit to a derived unit defined via the Avogadro constant. Span 231 gives the previous definition; span 50 confirms 6.02214076×10²³ entities per mole. Wikipedia 2019 revision establishes this change in unit status.
